name: team stat with week split only
description: Team stats from plays with week split but no year split. Verifies that team_stats CTE join does not reference a year column when year is not in splits, since the year filter is applied in the CTE WHERE clause.
expected_query:
with "base_years" as (SELECT unnest(ARRAY[2023]) as year), "player_years" as (SELECT DISTINCT player.pid, base_years.year FROM player CROSS JOIN base_years WHERE player.primary_position IN ('WR')), "player_years_weeks" as (SELECT player_years.pid, nfl_year_week_timestamp.year, nfl_year_week_timestamp.week FROM player_years INNER JOIN nfl_year_week_timestamp ON player_years.year = nfl_year_week_timestamp.year WHERE nfl_year_week_timestamp.year = 2023), "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7" as materialized (select "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team" as "nfl_team", SUM(pass_yards) AS team_pass_yds_from_plays, "nfl_plays"."week" from "nfl_plays" where "play_type" in ('PASS', 'RUSH', 'KOFF', 'PUNT', 'FGXP', 'FREE') and "nfl_plays"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_plays"."season_year" in (2023) group by "nfl_plays"."offense_nfl_team", "nfl_plays"."week"), "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats" as materialized (select "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7"."nfl_team", sum(t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7.team_pass_yds_from_plays) as team_pass_yds_from_plays, "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7"."week" from "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7" group by "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7"."nfl_team", "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7"."week"), "player_week_appearances" as (select "player_gamelogs"."pid", "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week", "nfl_games"."esbid" as "esbid", "player_gamelogs"."nfl_team" as "nfl_team" from "player_gamelogs" inner join "nfl_games" on "nfl_games"."esbid" = "player_gamelogs"."esbid" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023) and "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023)), "player_week_teams" as (select "pid", "year", "week", "esbid", "nfl_team", max(nfl_team) over (partition by pid, year, appearance_group) as nfl_team_most_recent from (select "spine_players"."pid", "spine"."year", "spine"."week", "week_appearance"."esbid", "week_appearance"."nfl_team", count(week_appearance.nfl_team) over (partition by spine_players.pid, spine.year order by spine.week rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as appearance_group from (select distinct "player_gamelogs"."pid", "player_gamelogs"."season_year" as "year" from "player_gamelogs" where "player_gamelogs"."season_year" in (2023)) as "spine_players" inner join (select distinct "nfl_games"."season_year" as "year", "nfl_games"."week" as "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) as "spine" on "spine"."year" = "spine_players"."year" left join "player_week_appearances" as "week_appearance" on "week_appearance"."pid" = "spine_players"."pid" and "week_appearance"."year" = "spine"."year" and "week_appearance"."week" = "spine"."week") as "player_week_team_spine"), "player_participation_weeks" as (SELECT pid, year, week, bool_or(is_active) AS is_active
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, g.week, pgl.is_active
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year, week), "player_years_teams" as (SELECT pid, year, array_agg(DISTINCT team_code) AS teams
          FROM (SELECT pgl.pid, 2023::int AS year, pgl.nfl_team AS team_code
       FROM player_gamelogs_year_2023 pgl
       INNER JOIN nfl_games g ON g.esbid = pgl.esbid
       WHERE g.season_type = 'REG' AND g.season_year = 2023) src
          GROUP BY pid, year), "team_weeks_played" as (select distinct "team", "year", "week" from ((select "home_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023)) union all (select "away_nfl_team" as "team", "season_year" as "year", "week" from "nfl_games" where "nfl_games"."season_type" in ('REG') and "nfl_games"."season_year" in (2023))) as "g") select "player"."pid", player.first_name, player.last_name, "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats"."team_pass_yds_from_plays" AS "team_pass_yds_from_plays_0", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END AS participation_status, "player"."primary_position" from "player" inner join "player_years_weeks" on "player_years_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" left join "player_week_teams" on "player_week_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_week_teams"."year" = 2023 and "player_week_teams"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats" on "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats"."nfl_team" = "player_week_teams"."nfl_team_most_recent" and t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats.week = player_years_weeks.week left join "player_participation_weeks" on "player_participation_weeks"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_participation_weeks"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" and "player_participation_weeks"."week" = "player_years_weeks"."week" left join "player_years_teams" on "player_years_teams"."pid" = "player"."pid" and "player_years_teams"."year" = "player_years_weeks"."year" where player.primary_position IN ('WR') group by player.first_name, player.last_name, "t43a888c621d3f08435232dd6603579a7_team_stats"."team_pass_yds_from_plays", "player_years_weeks"."week", CASE
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.is_active THEN 'active'
     WHEN player_participation_weeks.pid IS NULL
          AND player_years_teams.teams IS NOT NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM team_weeks_played
            WHERE team_weeks_played.year = player_years_weeks.year
              AND team_weeks_played.week = player_years_weeks.week
              AND team_weeks_played.team = ANY(player_years_teams.teams)
          )
       THEN 'bye'
     ELSE NULL
   END, "player"."pid", "player"."last_name", "player"."first_name", "player"."primary_position" order by 4 DESC NULLS LAST, "player"."pid" asc limit 500
